en_title: Dan Houser Reveals How 9/11 Changed GTA Forever
subtitle: 两个晚上的创作
opus_summary: Dan Houser透露，9·11事件后，《侠盗猎车手3》因原封面含燃烧建筑而临时换图。新封面用约两个晚上完成，拼格风格沿用至今，游戏也删改内容并推迟发售。

paragraphs.en: There’s arguably no more recognisable style of cover art than that of the Grand Theft Auto series. The panelled collection of images featuring characters and locations from each open world that has adorned each game box from 2001’s GTA 3 to the upcoming GTA 6 is etched into each of our minds. It all nearly looked completely different, though.
paragraphs.cn: 要说游戏封面风格的辨识度，恐怕没有哪个系列能超过《侠盗猎车手》。从2001年的《侠盗猎车手3》到即将推出的《GTA6》，各作都将开放世界中的人物和地点拼成分格图案，印在游戏包装盒上。这种设计早已刻在我们每个人的脑海里。不过，它差一点就会是完全不同的模样。

paragraphs.en: We spoke to Dan Houser, former VP at Rockstar and writer of almost all of the studio’s games from 1999 until 2018’s Red Dead Redemption 2, as part of our IGN30 Icons Series. When reminiscing about the developer’s most famous series, Grand Theft Auto, Houser shared how it felt to see elements of his creation permeate into the real world.
paragraphs.cn: 在IGN30标志人物系列访谈中，我们采访了Rockstar前副总裁Dan Houser。从1999年到2018年的《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，工作室几乎所有游戏的编剧工作都有他的参与。回顾Rockstar最知名的《侠盗猎车手》系列时，Houser谈到了看见自己创作中的元素渗入现实世界的感受。

paragraphs.en: “GTA has become part of the wider cultural fabric,” he said. “I mean, you sort of saw that on YouTube clips and whatever else that would have the HUD on it, and people using the logo and things like that. When you go to any big tourist resort, you'll have a sort of GTA cover art-inspired T-shirt available. So you began to see that creep in 10 years ago, so I suppose.”
paragraphs.cn: 「《GTA》已经融入了更广泛的文化，」他说。「比如，你会在YouTube短片或其他内容里看到它的HUD，也会看到人们使用它的标志之类的东西。去任何大型旅游度假地，都能买到以《GTA》封面为灵感的T恤。所以我想，大概10年前，你就开始看到这些元素慢慢渗入现实了。」

paragraphs.en: The bold, colourful style of that cover art came out of tragedy, though, as Houser revealed that the original look for GTA 3’s box had to be changed at the last minute due to the New York terror attack on September 11, 2011.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这种大胆、色彩鲜明的封面风格却源自一场悲剧。Houser透露，由于2011年9月11日纽约发生恐怖袭击，《侠盗猎车手3》的原版包装封面不得不在最后关头更换。

paragraphs.en: “What's funny is the cover art that became the iconic GTA cover art; Stephen Bliss did that in about two evenings because the old cover art was probably being too offensive to release after 9/11 because they were burning buildings in it,” Houser revealed. “So it would've been fine if there hadn't just been 9/11. So that look of the shards, the squares that became very iconic, only appeared because of 9/11.”
paragraphs.cn: 「有意思的是，后来成为《GTA》标志的那张封面，Stephen Bliss只用了大约两个晚上就完成了。旧封面里有燃烧的建筑，在9·11之后拿它发行游戏，恐怕太冒犯了，」Houser透露。「如果不是刚刚发生了9·11，旧封面本来不会有问题。所以，后来极具辨识度的那种碎片、方格拼接的样式，完全是因为9·11才出现的。」

paragraphs.en: These changes, as well as some involving the actual content of the game, meant a slight delay for GTA 3 from its originally planned release date of October 3, 2001 to October 22. Though only a few weeks, it piled on the pressure for Rockstar and Houser, who were by no means sure it would become the landmark success it eventually did.
paragraphs.cn: 封面的更换，加上游戏内容的一些调整，让《侠盗猎车手3》的发售日期从原定的2001年10月3日小幅推迟至10月22日。虽然只延期了几周，却让Rockstar和Houser承受了更大的压力。当时，他们远不能确定游戏会取得后来那样具有里程碑意义的成功。

paragraphs.en: “So I remember in early 2001, Take-Two was on the point of economic failure at the time,” Houser recalled. “We were struggling to get the game done, but we thought the game was going to be amazing and took it to E3 on the show floor and nobody cared about it. So that was dispiriting up to a point. And then the game came out six, seven months later. And that was just after 9/11.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我记得2001年初，Take-Two当时已经濒临财务崩溃，」Houser回忆道。「我们费了很大劲才把游戏做完，但我们觉得它会非常出色，于是把它带到E3展会上展示，结果根本没人在意。这多少有些让人泄气。然后，游戏在六七个月后发售，恰好是在9·11之后不久。」

paragraphs.en: GTA 3, of course, takes place in Liberty City, a fictionalised version of New York City, so you can see why a change in approach was needed. “There were a couple of bits of content that would've been fine, but in the exact aftermath of 9/11, were maybe a little bit too much,” Houser explained. “So we had to take those out, and the team will rally round and remove those and edit a couple of lines of dialogue and did a quick content stand and thought it was fine. And then the game came out in October of 2001. It kind of was a gradual all the way through till Christmas 2001 into early 2002, and it just didn't stop selling. It's not like any single week was that massive. It was that every week it just rumbled on.”
paragraphs.cn: 《侠盗猎车手3》的故事发生在自由城，这座虚构城市以纽约为原型，因此不难理解为什么制作团队需要调整处理方式。「有几处内容本来没什么问题，但在9·11刚刚发生之后，可能就有点过头了，」Houser解释道。「所以我们必须把它们删掉。团队齐心协力，删掉了这些内容，修改了几句台词，又快速检查了一遍内容，觉得没问题了。然后，游戏在2001年10月发售。销量就这样逐渐增长，一直持续到2001年圣诞节，再到2002年初，始终没有停下来。并不是某一周的销量特别惊人，而是每一周都持续卖得很好。」

paragraphs.en: Some of these tweaks were detailed by Houser in a 2011 interview with Edge magazine. "As far as I recall, we changed the colour of the cop cars so they weren't identical to NYPD, we altered the flight path of a plane so that it didn't look like it was flying into or behind a skyscraper, and we removed one mission as it made a reference to terrorists,” he said at the time.
paragraphs.cn: Houser在2011年接受《Edge》杂志采访时，曾详细介绍过其中一些调整。「据我回忆，我们更改了警车的颜色，让它们不再与纽约警察局的警车完全一样；我们调整了一架飞机的飞行路线，让它看起来不再像是飞进摩天大楼或飞到楼后；还删除了一个任务，因为其中提到了恐怖分子，」他当时说道。

paragraphs.en: The first 3D Grand Theft Auto wasn’t the only piece of media that had to make alterations in the wake of the terror attacks. Other video games, such as EA’s Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2, had to redesign its packaging , and Hideo Kojima’s Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty had sections involving the destruction of parts of Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty removed .
paragraphs.cn: 这部首度采用3D的《侠盗猎车手》并不是唯一一部在恐怖袭击后不得不修改的作品。其他电子游戏也做了调整，例如EA的《命令与征服：红色警戒2》不得不重新设计包装，小岛秀夫的《潜龙谍影2：自由之子》则删除了涉及曼哈顿部分地区及自由女神像遭到摧毁的片段。

paragraphs.en: Other cases include the trailer for Sam Raimi’s Spider-Man having to be recut to remove a helicopter being caught in a giant web between the World Trade Center towers. Men in Black 2 underwent huge reshoots for similar reasons, and planned sequels to both True Lies and Forrest Gump were cancelled.
paragraphs.cn: 其他例子还包括Sam Raimi执导的《蜘蛛侠》：其预告片不得不重新剪辑，删除一架直升机被困在世贸中心双塔之间巨型蛛网上的画面。《黑衣人2》因类似原因大规模补拍，而《真实的谎言》和《阿甘正传》原本计划中的续集都被取消了。

paragraphs.en: 25 years on, the same template for GTA game covers is still being used. You can check out all of the details we picked out from GTA 6’s art reveal here . For more on GTA 6, you can read our full interview with Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson , how the game will tackle the current political climate , and why Dan Houser says he won’t be playing it .
paragraphs.cn: 25年过去了，《GTA》的游戏封面仍在沿用同一种设计模板。
